newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean vice defence minister dies - radio.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean vice defence minister dies - radio.

text.p: North Korea's vice defence minister, Kim Kwang-jin, died on Thursday, a South Korean monitoring agency on Friday quoted Pyongyang radio as saying.
The announcement came less than a week after the death of defence minister Choe Kwang.

Kim, the first vice minister of the North Korean People's Armed Forces, died aged 69 of an "incurable sickness", the British Broadcasting Corporation separately quoted the Pyongyang radio report as saying.
The funeral would take place on Saturday, the radio said.
Kim's superior died of a heart attack last Friday, North Korean official media reported.
Earlier this month, North Korea's Prime Minister was replaced and its chief ideologue defected to a South Korean diplomatic mission in Beijing.
